name: AD Password Spraying Review, Approved Response, and Verification
description: Detect suspected spraying, require local review for the exact request, then verify all account states after the approved response.
important_note: This is a sanitized design template. Shuffle webhook, app, action, and authentication identifiers are installation-specific and intentionally omitted.

response_routing.pending_approval: Preserve request_id and original alert; await local operator review.
response_routing.verified: Require success=true, verified=true, dry_run=false, and five verified accounts.
response_routing.already_processed: Historical previous_result only; show verification timestamp.
response_routing.partial_failure: Route HTTP 500 body to analyst review; no automatic retries.
response_routing.requires_review: Stop and inspect state and AD before recovery.

nodes.name: Local Operator Approval
nodes.authority: Protected local state on DC-01; no HTTP approval endpoint.
nodes.note: An alert severity or caller-supplied approved flag is not approval.

nodes.name: Resume Original Response
nodes.note: Configure this review/resume path in the lab. The connector does not automatically resend duplicate detections.

nodes.name: Record Verified Result or Escalate
nodes.on_failure: Retain per-account results and request_id for operator review. Do not automatically retry changes.
nodes.audit_4725: Separate Splunk audit search; not performed by the responder.

security_controls: Local expiring approval bound to request identity
AD state readback on the same DC
Persistent processing claim and historical replay result
